snippet.title: Sigma Star Saga DX - Story Trailer - LAUNCHES APRIL 7
snippet.description: On April 7, shoot-’em-up action meets RPG exploration when Sigma Star Saga DX launches on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, and Steam! Play as ace pilot turned intergalactic double agent Ian Recker and enlist in the Krill empire to learn the aliens’ secret plans! But how far are you willing to go to save Earth? Whose side are you really on? Allegences will be tested in this updated version of the GBA classic! Get more info at: https://wayforward.com/games/sigma-star-saga-dx
